The Provincial Health Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa is seeking a single accountable partner to supply, implement, integrate, and sustain an integrated HMIS across four tertiary-care hospitals—standardizing patient care workflows while enabling province-level visibility, governance, and performance management through a central data warehouse and dashboards.

We understand the HMIS must provide end-to-end clinical and administrative coverage: EMR with OPD/IPD workflows, LIS/RIS connectivity, pharmacy and inventory control, billing and insurance claims processing, and interoperable integration with existing hospital systems and devices using HL7 v2.x and FHIR R4. Success also depends on structured migration of legacy patient records with documented validation and reconciliation, so clinicians can trust continuity of care and reporting from day one.

The Department’s context requires robust security, accountability, and operational resilience. We note the mandatory controls for role-based access, audit trails, and encryption, plus the availability target of 99.5% with a disaster recovery site and a 4-hour RTO. We also recognize that adoption is a primary risk, hence the need for structured end-user and administrator training for approximately 1,200 staff and three years of post-implementation support with a 24/7 help desk and defined SLAs.

TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is SECP incorporated and FBR ATL-registered, and holds ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and CMMI Level 3, with PMP-certified project managers available for assignment. [CO-PROFILE] Our experience includes multiple hospital IT deployments for provincial and federal government and international clients. [CAP-018][CAP-042][CAP-006][CAP-030]

Mandatory gap: our library does not yet evidence a valid CMMI Level 5 appraisal; we will address this requirement through compliant teaming/partnering and documented governance in the bid submission. [CO-PROFILE]
